| description = She stands around the upper floor of the Haggle Baron, behind a locked door that can supposedly not be picked regardless of skill level, and requires a key that will never be implemented on Project 1999 (see related quest.)

You can pull her with /target and pet attack, or by casting spells through the door. Ranged attacks seem to work through the door as well.

Clipping through the wall via the room next door is mentioned on Alakazam, however it's not confirmed to work on Project 1999.
